notice: Demonstration guidance requiring clinical review before production use.
emergencyCallInstruction: Call 112 now. Put the phone on speaker and follow the emergency operator's instructions.
doActions: If the person is not breathing normally, follow the operator's CPR instructions.
Use an AED only if one is available and you can follow its prompts.
doNotActions: Do not delay the emergency call.
Do not give food, drink, or medicine.
escalationRule: Keep 112 connected and report any change immediately.
